# 项目: spectral_collapse_ews

- 服务器名: rtx6000-diagprobe

连接服务器后先调 `detect_image` 检测是否为预置镜像。如果匹配，跳过基础环境搭建，只装项目特有依赖。已预装的包不要重复安装。

## 输出风格
回复简洁直接。只输出执行结果和必要信息，不要解释过程、不要客套、不要给未被要求的建议。

- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

content.content: {"result":"{\"success\": true, \"data\": {\"stdout\": \"\\\\begin{abstract}\\nRecursive synthetic data training causes model collapse, manifested spectrally as monotonic decline in the effective rank of learned representations.\\nExisting approaches either diagnose collapse post-hoc or apply static real-data mixing ratios that ignore its non-linear acceleration across generations.\\nWe propose, to our knowledge, the first closed-loop early warning system (EWS) that monitors spectral health online and drives a budget-constrained proportional controller to adaptively redistribute real data across training generations.\\nOur controller tracks the normalized decline rate of effective rank and applies reactive boosts when collapse pressure exceeds a calibrated threshold, while guaranteeing that total real-data consumption equals that of a uniform baseline.\\n% Results to be updated after experiments\\nWe evaluate spectral-guided adaptive allocation on Pythia-410M across 10 recursive generations. \\\\textbf{[TBD: key finding]}\\nOur framework provides practitioners with an automated mechanism to balance synthetic data efficiency against representation quality degradation in recursive training pipelines.\\n\\\\end{abstract}\\n\", \"stderr\": \"\", \"return_code\": 0}, \"error\": null, \"metadata\": {\"elapsed_seconds\": 0.43}}"}

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "\section{Conclusion}

We presented a closed-loop framework connecting spectral collapse monitoring to budget-constrained adaptive real-data allocation during recursive synthetic training.
Our contributions are threefold:

\paragraph{Spectral collapse characterization.}
Our Phase~0 pilot on Pythia-410M reveals \textbf{[TBD: spectral trajectory characterization]}. % FILL AFTER PHASE 0 GO/NO-GO

\paragraph{Online early warning signal.}
We introduce a normalized decline rate computed from the exponentially smoothed effective rank as an online EWS.
This signal detects incipient collapse before significant accuracy degradation, enabling preemptive intervention.

\paragraph{Adaptive proportional controller.}
We design a budget-constrained proportional controller that redistributes a fixed real-data budget temporally---concentrating real data at generations where collapse pressure is highest.
By construction, total real-data consumption is identical to uniform allocation; only the temporal schedule differs.
Experiments show this achieves \textbf{[TBD]} improvement in perplexity and \textbf{[TBD]} in downstream accuracy over the uniform baseline.
% Results to be updated after experiments

\subsection{Limitations}
% To be refined after experiments
\begin{itemize}[nosep]
  \item Validated on a single model family (Pythia-410M~\cite{biderman2023pythia}); generalization to other architectures remains unverified.
  \item Fixed data scale (50K samples per generation from The Pile~\cite{gao2020pile}).
  \item Controller hyperparameters ($\tau$, $k$) require offline calibration from a Phase~0 pilot run.
  \item Evaluated on a single text domain; multi-domain robustness is untested.
  \item Phase~0 go/no-go judgment is based on a single seed (\texttt{seed=42}); Phase~1 introduces 3-seed statistical testing.
  \item Any 1B scale-transfer results are from a single-seed pilot only.
\end{itemize}

\subsection{Future Work}
% To be refined
\begin{itemize}[nosep]
  \item Cross-architecture validation (Llama, Mistral) and scaling to larger models.
  \item Online calibration of controller thresholds, eliminating the need for a pilot run.
  \item Integration with RLHF/DPO alignment pipelines where synthetic data is pervasive.
  \item Extension to multi-modal settings where representation collapse may manifest differently.
\end{itemize}
